verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect programmatic surfaces: the help docs mention automating tasks with Shortcuts, and community users describe scriptable command-line tools like pbcopy/pbpaste and fs_usage. Nothing documents a public API for driving the OS, and OpenAPI probes against Apple's support site returned 404. missing for 10: documented public OS automation/scripting API reference, evidence of programmatic control beyond Shortcuts and ad-hoc CLI utilities, first-party API docs for agent-driven control, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
